title: gentorite
description: The gentorite Mod adds new armor and tools, which are successors of Netherite tools
body:
### > ****Gentorite – The Best Ore for Minecraft****

Discover Gentorite, a powerful new ore that brings your Minecraft gameplay to the next level!

Found deep underground between Y-levels -12 to -57, Gentorite is rarer than Netherite and even more rewarding. Once mined, it drops Gentorite Gems directly — no smelting required, just like diamonds!

With these gems, you can craft an entirely new set of Gentorite Tools, Armor, and Blocks. Gentorite gear is designed as the next evolution after Netherite, offering superior strength, durability, and style.

---

### > ****🧱 What This Mod Adds:****

🪨 A new ore: Gentorite Ore generates deep in the Overworld.

💎 Direct drops: Mine the ore to get Gentorite Gems — no furnace needed!

⚔️ New weapons and tools: Stronger and faster than Netherite.

🛡️ Advanced armor: Highly durable and combat-ready.

🧱 Gentorite blocks: For storage or stylish building.


Upgrade your Minecraft world with Gentorite — the ultimate late-game material!


---

### > ****🔧 Installation Guide:****

1. Make sure you have Minecraft Forge installed (depending on the mod version).


2. Download the Gentorite Mod .jar file.


3. Place the .jar file into your Minecraft mods folder.

(You can find this folder by going to %appdata%/.minecraft/mods on Windows.)



4. Launch Minecraft using your modded profile.


5. Enjoy Gentorite mod 
###
